migrations.name: 0001_friends
migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS friendships ( user_a TEXT NOT NULL, user_b TEXT NOT NULL, requester TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', a_login TEXT NOT NULL, b_login TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, accepted_at INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (user_a, user_b) ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_friends_a ON friendships(user_a, status); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_friends_b ON friendships(user_b, status);
